title.narrative: Education for sustainable development focused on protection of biodiversity in the MAB Sites; Using waste management as alternative income for youth and women.

description.narrative:
This activity will involve youth organizations / students in the promotion biodiversity protection. It includes reforestation, waste collection and awareness activities in the MAB sites. (Communication materials will be used: e.g., videos, infographic brochures, website stories, social media campaign). Knowledges Exchange will be made with AfriMAB/ArabMAB.
Promoting alternative uses of waste material for improving sustainable management of the MAB Sites. This will involve the transformation of waste collected in the MAB sites as models/examples of recycled products to encourage sustainable waste management and promote alternative sources of income. A workshop will be organized to promote these models. A video and web article will be prepared to promote share the outcomes of the workshops. This activity include knowledge sharing on waste reuse and recycling activities in St Kitts and Sao tome and the no plastic campaign in Cuba building on the experience of Sao Tomé & Principe.
